rows.commentary: 0.1: Arshdeep Singh begins with a full delivery swinging away, pushed firmly by Shai Hope straight to mid-off along the ground.
0.2: Arshdeep Singh darts this one in sharply from a length to rap Shai Hope on the pads, prompting a brief and ultimately dismissed review discussion from India.
0.3: Dot ball from Arshdeep Singh to Shai Hope.
0.4: Arshdeep Singh drifts it into Shai Hope, who opens the face and punches it crisply down the ground for four to long-off.
0.5: Arshdeep Singh fires it in full at 134.1kph just outside off, and Shai Hope brings the bat straight down to dead-bat it toward mid-off.
0.6: Arshdeep Singh chases the inswinging yorker but slips into a low full toss on the stumps, allowing Shai Hope to clip it away to the right of mid-on for a single.
1.1: Mayank Yadav steams in at a blistering 147kph, but Shai Hope meets it with supreme authority, dispatching it to the fence for four.
1.2: Mayank Yadav fires it in again, and Shai Hope stands tall, launching it straight down the ground with pristine timing for back-to-back boundaries.
1.3: Dot ball from Mayank Yadav to Shai Hope.
1.4: Shai Hope does not score off Mayank Yadav.
1.5: Four to Shai Hope off Mayank Yadav.
1.6: Four to Shai Hope off Mayank Yadav.
2.1: Arshdeep Singh delivers a soaring high full-toss outside off, and Kamil Pooran slices it in the air past short third man for four, earning a free hit with a brilliant opening of the bat face.
2.1: Arshdeep Singh fires in a low full-toss on leg stump, and Kamil Pooran clears space to drive it straight to the mid-off fielder, letting a golden free-hit scoring opportunity slip away.
2.2: Arshdeep Singh attacks with a full, wide delivery outside off, and Kamil Pooran reaches out with eyes locked on a square drive.
2.3: Arshdeep Singh fires in a vicious inswinging yorker at middle-stump, dug out cleanly toward gully by Kamil Pooran for a single.
2.4: Arshdeep Singh steers it into the stride of the mid-off fielder, ticking the scoreboard over with a single for Shai Hope.
2.5: Dot ball from Arshdeep Singh to Kamil Pooran.
2.6: Arshdeep Singh drops it full and wide, tempting Kamil Pooran into a reach that finds only the extra-cover fielder.
3.1: Axar Patel floats it full on off, and Shai Hope clears room to drive only to spoon a mistimed return catch.
3.2: Axar Patel pushes it through, and Shai Hope rotates the strike smoothly down to long-off for a single.
3.3: Axar Patel darts it quicker into middle and leg, prompting Kamil Pooran back to his crease to tuck it smoothly into the vacant spaces of mid-wicket for a single.
3.4: Shai Hope takes a single off Axar Patel.
3.5: Axar Patel floats it slower and fuller on middle, and Kamil Pooran clears room to carve a gorgeous boundary over the lifted off-side ring.
3.6: Axar Patel fires it full just outside off, allowing Kamil Pooran to lean forward and loft a drive down towards long-off for one.
4.1: Arshdeep Singh drops it full on middle, and Kamil Pooran creates space before driving it wide of extra-cover to turn the strike over.
4.2: A bye off Arshdeep Singh's delivery to Shai Hope.

4.3: Arshdeep Singh strikes precisely as the powerplay script demands, sliding a very full delivery on that relentless red line outside off right through Kamil Pooran's defenses to send him back for 12.
4.4: Arshdeep Singh delivers to Shimron Hetmyer, who dispatches it away to the backward square leg boundary for four.
4.5: Arshdeep Singh sends it down to Shimron Hetmyer, who guides it away toward deep backward point for a single.
4.6: Arshdeep Singh delivers to Shai Hope, who taps it cleanly square of the wicket to scamper through for a brisk single.
5.1: Axar Patel floats this one full on the middle stump, and Shai Hope strides forward to dead-bat it back down the pitch.
5.2: Axar Patel delivers to Shai Hope, and chaos erupts as Shimron Hetmyer is run out for 5 by the sharp combination of Tilak Varma and Sanju Samson.
5.3: No run for Rovman Powell off Axar Patel.
5.4: Dot ball from Axar Patel to Rovman Powell.
5.5: Axar Patel delivers the coup de grâce, flattening Rovman Powell's stumps as the batsman departs for a duck.
5.6: Sherfane Rutherford does not score off Axar Patel.
6.1: Kuldeep Yadav fires it in flat and on a good length to middle, and Shai Hope drops back to tuck it out to deep square-leg for an easy couple.
6.2: Kuldeep Yadav keeps it flat on a good length outside off, and Shai Hope rocks back to punch it straight back into the bowler's hands.
6.3: Kuldeep Yadav finds the bat of Shai Hope once more, picking up two comfortable runs out toward extra cover.
6.4: Kuldeep Yadav drifts it in, Shai Hope sweeps it firmly away into the deep mid-wicket grass for a single.
6.5: Kuldeep Yadav drops the googly in, totally bamboozling Sherfane Rutherford who flashes hard and slices it away to the rope for four.
6.6: No run for Sherfane Rutherford off Kuldeep Yadav.
7.1: Mayank Yadav steams in and hovers a searing 144.7kph wide length delivery past the groping drive of Shai Hope.
7.2: Mayank Yadav rolls his fingers over a slower short ball, and Shai Hope steps forward to pull it down to deep square-leg for a single.
7.3: Mayank Yadav is met by Sherfane Rutherford, who pushes the delivery down to long-on for a comfortable single.
7.4: Mayank Yadav rolls out the slower off-cutter, flicked airborne but safely into the gap wide of deep mid-wicket by Shai Hope for an easy couple.
7.5: Mayank Yadav bamboozles Shai Hope with a full slower-ball off-cutter outside off, the premeditated reverse-scoop catching a thin edge to trickle harmlessly to Sanju Samson.
7.6: Leg byes off Mayank Yadav's delivery to Shai Hope, 4 runs in all.
8.1: Kuldeep Yadav loops it up, and Sherfane Rutherford launches it majestically over extra cover for a maximum!

8.2: Kuldeep Yadav hangs this full delivery out on off, inviting Sherfane Rutherford forward, who accepts the challenge with a soft defensive push in front of cover and scampers through for a quick single.
8.3: Kuldeep Yadav fires it in flat on a good length at the middle stump, Shai Hope makes room off the back foot and drives it straight back at the bowler.
8.4: Kuldeep Yadav sticks to that flat good length on leg stump, and Hope works it off the back foot into the deep backward square leg region for a single.
8.5: Kuldeep Yadav targets the good length outside off, it stays low, and Sherfane Rutherford cuts it away behind backward point to collect a run.
8.6: Kuldeep Yadav loops it up, and Shai Hope launches it soaring high and handsome over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
9.1: Naman Dhir fires it full and down the leg-side, catching a mistimed sweep from Sherfane Rutherford before Arshdeep mops it up cleanly at deep backward square-leg for a single.
9.2: Naman Dhir delivers a flat, good-length ball that grips and turns sharply into leg-stump, allowing Shai Hope to drop back and tuck it away into deep square-leg for one.
9.3: Naman Dhir angles it in on a good length, and Sherfane Rutherford watches it whistle through, appealing in vain for the wide.
9.4: Naman Dhir strays slightly and Sherfane Rutherford punishes it square of the wicket for a boundary.
9.5: Naman Dhir extracts vicious turn and bounce as the off-break rips past Sherfane Rutherford's forward prod and beats the outside edge.
9.6: Sherfane Rutherford does not score off Naman Dhir.
10.1: Axar Patel floats it up to Shai Hope, who dispatches it for four, leaving Mayank Yadav crestfallen with his fielding effort at short third man.
10.2: Axar Patel drops it on a flat good length outside off, and Shai Hope strides forward to punch it out to sweeper cover for a single.
10.3: Axar Patel floats it up full outside leg, and Sherfane Rutherford sweeps it away into the deep where Naman Dhir sprints across to cut it off, saving the boundary as they scamper back for two.
10.4: Axar Patel delivers full on middle, and Sherfane Rutherford improvises with a sprawling reverse-sweep that dribbles awkwardly past backward point and short third man for four.
10.5: Axar Patel floats it up to Sherfane Rutherford, who dispatches it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum, strengthening the partnership with Shai Hope.
10.6: Axar Patel floats it up to Sherfane Rutherford, who sweeps it away firmly into the deep mid-wicket pocket for a single.
11.1: Naman Dhir tosses it up full on off stump, and Sherfane Rutherford steps forward with a straight bat to push it firmly back to the bowler.
11.2: Naman Dhir slides a slower one down leg, Sherfane Rutherford misses the sweep entirely as it deflects off the body for a single leg bye to short fine leg.
11.3: Naman Dhir drops it into the arc, and Shai Hope launches it monstrously over mid-wicket for a maximum.
11.4: Naman Dhir strikes immediately after the milestone, enticing Shai Hope into the mistimed shot that safely nests in the hands of Axar Patel to end a sparkling 52.
11.5: Naman Dhir drops it on a sharp off-break, turning into off and middle, as Roston Chase steps back onto the crease and flicks it away to deep backward square-leg to get off the mark.
11.6: Naman Dhir tosses it full on off, drawing Sherfane Rutherford forward to push wide of extra-cover where a cleaner pick-up by Shreyas might have spelled disaster.
12.1: Kuldeep Yadav floats it up full to Sherfane Rutherford, who pushes it past the bowler as a sluggish dive from Kuldeep allows a comfortable run.
12.2: Kuldeep Yadav goes full and Roston Chase punishes it straight down the ground, driving it ferociously away to the boundary for four.
12.3: Kuldeep Yadav strikes as Roston Chase is trapped right in front, pinned plumb lbw for 5.
12.4: Dot ball from Kuldeep Yadav to Romario Shepherd.

12.5: Kuldeep Yadav lands this good length delivery on off and middle, turning sharply back in as Romario Shepherd stays back on the crease and punches it off the thick inner half straight to mid-wicket.
12.6: Kuldeep Yadav fires this one flat and on a good length on middle, and Romario Shepherd stays back once more to punch it down the ground toward long-on for a single.
13.1: Naman Dhir delivers to Romario Shepherd, launched over the rope with absolute authority for six!
13.2: Naman Dhir strikes as Romario Shepherd holes out to Tilak Varma, departing for a brisk seven from five balls.
13.3: Naman Dhir steams in to Matthew Forde, worked away toward deep mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
13.4: Naman Dhir fires it down to Sherfane Rutherford, nudged into the deep square leg region for a single.
13.5: No run for Matthew Forde off Naman Dhir.
13.6: Naman Dhir feeds it in to Matthew Forde, who tucks it sharply away into the mid-wicket region for a single.
14.1: Kuldeep Yadav floats it up to Matthew Forde, who slices it into the outfield where Ishan Kishan moves sharply to pluck out a stunning catch, sending Forde packing for two.
14.2: Dot ball from Kuldeep Yadav to Shamar Springer.
14.3: Kuldeep Yadav floats it up to Shamar Springer, who drives it firmly down to long-off for a single.
14.4: Kuldeep Yadav floats it up, and Sherfane Rutherford works it neatly away into the backward square leg region for a single.
14.5: Kuldeep Yadav keeps probing, and Shamar Springer turns this one gently towards short fine leg to rotate the strike.
14.6: Sherfane Rutherford does not score off Kuldeep Yadav.
15.1: Naman Dhir steams in and Shamar Springer nudges it away neatly to backward square leg for a single.
15.2: Naman Dhir delivers to Sherfane Rutherford, who nudges it toward short mid-wicket to pick up a single.

15.3: Naman Dhir drops the off-break into the strip, Shamar Springer aims a heavy swipe across the line, and the thick inside-edge ricochets off the left thigh pad to trickle agonizingly past the unguarded timber for a dot.
15.4: Naman Dhir comes round the wicket to Shamar Springer, digging into a good length outside off, and Springer unleashes the long handle to flat-bat it fiercely over long-on for six.
15.5: Naman Dhir strikes as Shamar Springer holes out to Axar Patel at deep mid-wicket, failing to get underneath the full delivery.
15.6: Naman Dhir keeps it flat on a good length outside off, drawing Akeal Hosein forward to push firmly toward cover.
16.1: Sherfane Rutherford takes a single off Mayank Yadav.
16.2: Akeal Hosein takes a single off Mayank Yadav.
16.3: No run for Sherfane Rutherford off Mayank Yadav.
16.4: No run for Sherfane Rutherford off Mayank Yadav.
16.5: Mayank Yadav drops it short and Sherfane Rutherford pounces, rocking back to hammer the pull hard and wide of deep mid-wicket for four.
16.6: Sherfane Rutherford finds the boundary off Mayank Yadav for four.
17.1: Arshdeep Singh darts it in and Akeal Hosein works it away square of the wicket for a single.
17.2: Arshdeep Singh drops it on a pinpoint yorker length outside off, and Sherfane Rutherford jams it away wide of short fine leg for a single.
17.3: Arshdeep Singh fires one in, and Akeal Hosein works it away into the deep mid-wicket region to hustle back for a comfortable couple.

17.4: Arshdeep Singh drops it back of a length on middle, and Akeal Hosein swivels with absolute flair to pull it effortlessly over the deep backward square-leg fence for six, drawing an appreciative smile even from his partner Sherfane Rutherford.

17.5: Arshdeep Singh rolls his fingers over the slower-ball off-cutter outside off on a length, and Akeal Hosein steps forward to open the face of the bat, guiding it wide of backward point for a single.

17.6: Arshdeep Singh drops it full, Rutherford dispatches it racing to the boundary, and under the watchful eye of the third umpire checking the cushion, that's a hard-fought fifty for Sherfane Rutherford!
18.1: Mayank Yadav launches it full on off, and Akeal Hosein steps forward, trusting his reach to loft it cleanly through the line for four.

18.2: Mayank Yadav drops it wide and slower, Akeal Hosein slashes and misses, and the missed glovework leaves Sanju Samson down on the turf clutching his right knee before he bravely rises to continue.
18.3: Mayank Yadav digs in a slower-ball off-cutter on leg-stump, and Sherfane Rutherford moves onto the back foot to pull it mightily over deep backward square-leg for a maximum.
18.4: Mayank Yadav drops it full into the stumps, Sherfane Rutherford drives firmly down to long-off, refusing the single as he demands to keep the strike.

18.5: Mayank Yadav bangs it full on the pads, Sherfane Rutherford clears the front leg for the heave, mistimes it entirely, and Naman Dhir settles underneath a simple catch at deep mid-wicket to end a 56-run knock.
18.6: Mayank Yadav bangs it in short and angled away, Shamar Joseph clears the front leg to pull and misses entirely as a dot ball concludes the over.
19.1: Axar Patel floats it up, Akeal Hosein slices the lofted drive straight into the waiting gloves of Ishan Kishan, and the dismissal is sealed with a sharp take.
0.1: Matthew Forde finds lovely inward shape from a good length, and Sanju Samson gets smartly behind the line to tuck it away through the on-side for a single.
0.2: Abhishek Sharma stands tall and belts this short, gentle delivery away with absolute disdain, launching it all the way for a maximum.
0.3: Matthew Forde streams in and Abhishek Sharma carves it away, sending the white ball racing through the turf to the deep extra cover fence for four.
0.4: Matthew Forde probes the off-stump channel with a tidy good-length ball, and Abhishek Sharma gets right behind it to drop into a cautious defensive posture.
0.5: Matthew Forde strays onto the pads from round the wicket without protection in the deep, allowing Abhishek Sharma to nonchalantly tickle it away to the fence.
0.6: Matthew Forde switches back over the wicket, zipping a short-of-length delivery wide of off stump that Abhishek Sharma happily watches sail past.
1.1: Akeal Hosein overcompensates with width and length, allowing Sanju Samson to stand tall, trust his hands, and drill the ball through cover for four.
1.2: Akeal Hosein drops it short and wide, prompting Sanju Samson to spring back and hammer a fierce cut that is brilliantly intercepted by the diving cover fielder.
1.3: Akeal Hosein darts this slider in from round the wicket onto the leg stump, and Abhishek Sharma just nudges it into the turf at short fine leg while barking out an immediate refusal for the run.
1.4: Abhishek Sharma clears his leg against Akeal Hosein and lofts the delivery safely into the turf ahead of the long-on fielder for a single.
1.5: Akeal Hosein keeps it tight, sliding this one into Sanju Samson who promptly nudges it toward mid-on for a brisk single.
1.6: Akeal Hosein suffocates Abhishek Sharma for room, yet the batter clears the infield with a lofted stroke over cover for a brace.
2.1: Roston Chase keeps it flat into the leg stump, allowing Sanju Samson to work it cleanly across to mid-wicket for a single.
2.2: Roston Chase feeds the width outside off, and Abhishek Sharma clears point with a carved slash to the rope.
2.3: Roston Chase alters his angle and claims the wicket as Abhishek Sharma holes out to Shimron Hetmyer to end a brisk knock.
2.4: Chase darts a flat trajectory into the stumps, finding the inside edge of Kishan's defensive push to collect two runs at fine leg.
2.5: Chase offers width, Kishan cuts sharply square, and Rutherford hurls himself rightward to cushion the blow.

2.6: Roston Chase feeds Sanju Samson a length ball that gets exquisitely punched off the back foot through cover, leaving Shamar Joseph to sprint and acrobatically flick it back just inches from the boundary foam.
3.1: Hosein fires it flat into the leg stump, and Samson quietly dead-bats it straight toward mid-wicket.
3.2: Samson clears leg to manufacture space, but Hosein chases him with a slider that is simply patted back to the bowler's hands.
3.3: Hosein strikes in his milestone hundredth T20I as Samson chips a tame return catch straight back to the ecstatic bowler.
3.4: Akeal Hosein teases this one into Shreyas Iyer, who shuffles back to dead-bat the turn toward cover.
3.5: Akeal Hosein fires it flatter into the stumps, allowing Shreyas Iyer to nudge a single down toward long-off.
3.6: Akeal Hosein sneaks one through low as Ishan Kishan shapes for the cut, only to drill it straight to the fielder stationed at cover-point.
4.1: Chase drops it flat and wide, allowing Iyer to manipulate the angle toward short third man for a single.
4.2: Roston Chase extracts sharp extra bounce from the surface, catching Ishan Kishan in two minds as the flick balloons harmlessly into the on-side.
4.3: Roston Chase drops it too short, allowing Ishan Kishan ample time to rock back and hammer a pull wide of mid-on all the way to the boundary.
4.4: Roston Chase hurries Ishan Kishan on the back foot, forcing a hurried defensive prod.
4.5: Roston Chase drops it short and Shreyas Iyer leaps back to ruthlessly slap it past point for four.
4.6: Chase darts it in flat, and Iyer steps back to ease the single through the deep mid-wicket region.
5.1: Shamar Joseph bangs it in around off, Shreyas Iyer steering it off the outer half past backward point to scamper back for a scampering couple.
5.2: Shamar Joseph serves a short-of-a-length delivery outside off, and Shreyas Iyer holds a magnificent pose after launching a back-foot lofted drive just inside the ropes.
5.3: Shamar Joseph strays slightly, allowing Shreyas Iyer to flick him away with supreme authority toward the deep mid-wicket boundary.
5.4: Shamar Joseph feels the full force of a hat-trick of boundaries as Shreyas Iyer dissects the field behind point with supreme authority.
5.5: Shamar Joseph spears this full delivery directly at Shreyas Iyer, who jams his bat down to dig it out toward mid-off.
5.6: Shamar Joseph digs it in short, hurrying Shreyas Iyer into a mishit pull that loops safely away from the scrambling Kamil Pooran.
6.1: Romario Shepherd drops it in on a length, and Shreyas Iyer calmly nudges it away into the deep mid-wicket turf for a single.
6.2: Romario Shepherd delivers on a good length outside off, tying Ishan Kishan up before a quick jab into the backward point region seals the single.
6.3: Romario Shepherd delivers on a good length targeting off, stifling Kishan who dabs it straight to point and completes a brisk single without hesitation.
6.4: Romario Shepherd drops it short, and Shreyas Iyer muscles the pull into the deep mid-wicket turf to hustle back for a brace.
6.5: Romario Shepherd fires another short delivery well outside off, and Shreyas Iyer ducks underneath it as the umpire waves away the wide appeal.
6.6: Romario Shepherd delivers a short of length ball on middle, allowing Shreyas Iyer to drop onto the back foot and nudge it out to deep mid-wicket for a single.
7.1: Shamar Joseph digs it in outside off, allowing Shreyas Iyer to angle the face and steer it toward the deep backward point fence.
7.2: Shamar Joseph digs it in short on middle, and Ishan Kishan retreats to the crease, jabbing it firmly down toward long-on for a single.
7.3: Shamar Joseph charges in to deliver a rising back of a length ball outside off, gently guided by Shreyas Iyer toward long-on to rotate the strike.
7.4: Shamar Joseph unleashes searing velocity off a back-of-a-length trajectory, startling Ishan Kishan with sudden lift that crashes squarely into the batter's forearm.
7.5: Shamar Joseph offers width with a slower delivery, and Ishan Kishan reaches out, scorching the drive past cover with devastating timing.
7.6: Shamar Joseph rattles in a sharp 140kph delivery that hurried Ishan Kishan into an awkward, miscue pull out to deep midwicket for a single.
8.1: Romario Shepherd strays slightly, allowing Ishan Kishan to flick it away cleanly toward the backward square leg boundary.
8.2: Shepherd bangs it short into the middle, and Ishan works it off the back foot out toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
8.3: Shepherd digs it in short, and Shreyas ruthlessly dispatches the pull into the deep mid-wicket gap for a boundary.
8.4: Romario Shepherd delivers full, and Shreyas Iyer shuffles across to launch it majestically over extra-cover for four.
8.5: Romario Shepherd goes back to Shreyas Iyer, who repeats the treatment and dispatches it over covers once more.
8.6: Romario Shepherd sends down the final ball of the over, pushed by Shreyas Iyer down towards long-on for a pair of runs.
9.1: Akeal Hosein drags it short and wide, prompting Ishan Kishan to slash hard toward extra-cover where Kamil completely fumbles the stop.
9.2: Akeal Hosein keeps it flat on a good length at the stumps, allowing Ishan Kishan to stay back and work a single down to deep point.
9.3: Akeal Hosein delivers a flat, probing length on middle, and Shreyas Iyer shimmies dynamically inside his crease.
9.4: Akeal Hosein delivers a flat, probing length on off stump, prompting Shreyas Iyer back to punch crisply toward extra-cover.
9.5: Akeal Hosein slides this one in to grip the surface awkwardly, denying Shreyas Iyer any chance of scoring.
9.6: Akeal Hosein loops this one through, Shreyas Iyer presses forward and pushes it out toward deep extra cover to collect a single.
10.1: Shamar Springer rolls his fingers across the seam on a length outside off, inviting Shreyas Iyer to douse the pace and guide it quietly toward backward point.
10.2: Shamar Springer pitches it up outside off, and Shreyas Iyer shifts his weight forward before flat-batting the delivery high and hard straight down the ground to long-off for four.
10.3: Shamar Springer delivers on a length, and Shreyas Iyer clips it away into the deep mid-wicket pocket to bring up his 11th T20I half-century.
10.4: Shamar Springer lands it on a length outside off, drawing a sharp slap straight to the cover fielder from Ishan Kishan for a dot.
10.5: Shamar Springer delivers to Ishan Kishan, yielding a single while the television official scrutinizes the legitimacy of a disputed outfield claim.
10.6: Shamar Springer pitches it up and Shreyas Iyer launches it violently over long-off, dispatching the delivery straight into the sightscreen for a maximum.
11.1: Roston Chase offers a full, tossed-up delivery on middle, and Ishan Kishan steps forward to drill it straight down to long-on for a single.
11.2: Roston Chase fires in a flat good-length ball that turns into middle, allowing Shreyas Iyer to drop onto the back foot and tuck it away to deep mid-wicket.
11.3: Roston Chase snaps through a quicker delivery just outside off, prompting Ishan Kishan onto the back foot to cut toward cover-point as they scamper across for a sharp single.
11.4: Chase floats one through at one hundred and ten kilometers per hour, angled directly into Iyer who nudges it away toward long-on for a single.
11.5: Roston Chase loops up a full delivery on middle, whipped away by Ishan Kishan to collect a comfortable single at long-on.
11.6: Roston Chase floats it up full outside off, and Shreyas Iyer swings hard at the slogsweep before the fielder slides right at deep mid-wicket to limit them to two.
12.1: Akeal Hosein delivers a flat, good length ball outside off, allowing Ishan Kishan to step back and punch it toward long-off for a single.
12.2: Akeal Hosein drops it on a length on middle, and Shreyas Iyer clears leg-side room before launching it majestically over deep extra cover for a maximum.
12.3: Akeal Hosein tails the length delivery outside the leg-stump, but Shreyas Iyer backs away to carve it just past the leaping extra-cover fielder for four.
12.4: The third umpire flashes the red light for a front-line infraction, gifting Akeal Hosein's flat length delivery to long-on as a no-ball and loading up a free-hit for Ishan Kishan.
12.4: Ishan Kishan shuffles across the good-length delivery outside off, skidding an awkward toe-edge away for a single and staring down his willow in frustration.
12.5: Akeal Hosein drops it in, and Shreyas Iyer works it securely into the depths of deep square leg for a rotation of the strike.
12.6: Akeal Hosein drags this slower length delivery wide outside off, and Ishan Kishan unleashes a ferocious straight punch that nearly takes the umpire's head off on its race to the boundary.
13.1: Matthew Forde delivers to Shreyas Iyer, who reads the legcutter early and dispatches it over the ropes for a maximum as he zeroes in on his century.

13.2: Matthew Forde rolls his fingers across the seam with a ninety-eight kph back-of-the-hand slower ball, only for Shreyas Iyer to crouch beneath the flight and club it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
13.3: Matthew Forde tests Shreyas Iyer who lofts it straight into the hands of Joseph at long-on, only for a dropped chance to grant a single.
13.4: Matthew Forde delivers outside off, and Ishan Kishan pushes it down to long-off for a single.
13.5: Matthew Forde goes around the wicket with a wayward full toss down leg that Shreyas Iyer expertly tickles away to the fine leg boundary.
13.6: Six to Shreyas Iyer off Matthew Forde.
14.1: Roston Chase angles it in from round the wicket, pinning Ishan Kishan right on the pads as the flick goes begging.
14.2: Roston Chase floats it full onto leg stump, inviting a smooth push down to long-on for a single.
14.3: Roston Chase absorbs the flight and Shreyas Iyer instantly responds, launching a towering maximum over the rope to bring up a magnificent maiden T20I hundred for India's captain.
14.4: Roston Chase fires an erratic throw after Shreyas Iyer pushes the yorker back, gifting an overthrow that seals a dominant eight-wicket victory for India.

venue.name: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium

preview.text: India and West Indies meet in a T20 at Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, where 30 recorded T20 meetings show 20 wins for India and 10 wins for West Indies. India won the toss and chose to bowl first, with the forecast for the next 8 hours showing up to a 24 per cent chance of rain and about 28 degrees, while the usual first-innings score in the 32 recorded T20 matches at the venue is 171.

summary.text: India won by 8 wkts after restricting WI innings to 171-10, where Sherfane Rutherford top-scored with 56 off 34 balls and Naman Dhir took 3 for 31. In response, IND innings reached 172-2 led by captain Shreyas Iyer with 102 off 43 balls, while Akeal Hosein took 1 for 37.
